description: This file contains database utility functions for a mobile service booking system, including database initialization, CRUD operations for bookings, brands, models, and problems, and configuration management via environment variables.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO format with seconds precision.

methods.name: get_db_path
methods.description: Retrieves the SQLite database path from environment variable or defaults to a local file.

methods.name: get_connection
methods.description: Creates and returns a SQLite connection with foreign keys enforced and row factory set.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Creates database tables for brands, models, problems, and bookings if they do not exist.

methods.name: _table_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if a specified table in the database is empty.

methods.name: seed_reference_data_if_empty
methods.description: Seeds initial data for brands, models, and problems if the tables are empty.

methods.name: rows_to_dicts
methods.description: Converts a list of sqlite3.Row objects to a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: create_booking
methods.description: Inserts a new booking record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: get_booking
methods.description: Fetches a booking with related brand, model, and problem names by ID.

methods.name: list_brands
methods.description: Returns a list of all brands.

methods.name: list_models
methods.description: Returns a list of models filtered by brand ID.

methods.name: list_problems
methods.description: Returns a list of all problems.

methods.name: list_admin_bookings
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of bookings with total count, supporting various filters and pagination.

methods.name: update_booking_status
methods.description: Updates the status of a booking by ID, returning True if successful.
